descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Tehnologie, informații și mass-media
Practice / Domain 
 Cyber Security – Telco Cloud & Network Security
 Experience Range 
 5 – 12 Years
 Support Model 
 24x7 Operations (Telco-grade SLA-driven environment)
 Role Summary 
 The Network Security Engineer is responsible for design, deployment, and operations of Telco-grade Virtual Firewalls (vFW) using Palo Alto technologies within Telco cloud (NFV/SDN) environments .
 This role ensures secure traffic segmentation, high availability, and scalable firewall deployments supporting carrier-grade networks, VNF architectures, and multi-tenant Telco environments .
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Telco Virtual Firewall (Palo Alto) Operations 
Deploy, configure, and manage Palo Alto Virtual Firewalls (VM-Series / CN-Series) in Telco cloud
Configure:
Security policies (App-ID, URL filtering, NAT, segmentation)
Threat prevention (IPS, Anti-malware, WildFire)
Perform log analysis, traffic inspection, and threat detection 
Ensure policy enforcement across Telco network segments and trust zones 
 2. Telco Cloud / NFV Security Implementation 
Deploy firewalls as Virtual Network Functions (VNFs) in Telco cloud environments
Integrate with:
NFV orchestrators / SDN controllers
Telco cloud platforms (OpenStack / Kubernetes)
Ensure:
Secure communication between VNFs
Controlled access using IP/Port/Application-level filtering
 3. Traffic Engineering & Connectivity Security 
Configure and manage:
Routing protocols (BGP, static routing)
VPNs (IPSec, site-to-site connectivity)
Perform deep packet inspection (DPI) and traffic flow analysis
Secure north-south and east-west traffic flows in Telco networks
 4. High Availability & Carrier-Grade Design 
Implement HA (active-active / active-passive) setups for virtual firewalls 
Support:
Geo-redundant deployments
Fault-tolerant designs aligned to Telco standards
Ensure no service impact from VNF/node/site failures 
 5. Monitoring, Incident & Change Management 
Monitor firewall health, logs, and alerts
Perform L2/L3 troubleshooting for high-severity incidents 
Execute change, incident, and problem management (ITIL aligned) 
Collaborate with NOC, SOC, and Telco operations teams 
 6. Governance, Compliance & Security Assurance 
Ensure firewall configurations meet:
Telco security standards (ETSI / NFV guidelines)
Enterprise compliance requirements
Support audits with logs, reports, and evidence
Perform policy optimization, cleanup, and compliance validation 
 Mandatory Skills 
 Core Technical Skills 
Hands-on experience with:
 Palo Alto Virtual Firewalls (VM-Series / CN-Series) 
 Panorama for centralized firewall management 
Strong knowledge of:
NGFW features (App-ID, User-ID, Content-ID, IPS)
Firewall policy design and segmentation
 Telco / Cloud Exposure 
Experience in:
 Telco cloud / NFV environments 
Virtual firewall deployments at scale
Understanding of:
VNF lifecycle and orchestration
SDN-based network security
 Networking Fundamentals 
Strong understanding of:
TCP/IP, BGP, routing, NAT
Network segmentation and Zero Trust
Experience with:
VPNs (IPSec, SSL VPN)
Traffic analysis and debugging
 Desired / Good-to-Have Skills 
Experience with:
Multi-vendor Telco firewalls
Kubernetes / container security (CN-Series)
Automation:
Python / Ansible / REST APIs
Exposure to:
5G / LTE network security
Cloud-native security controls
 Certifications (Preferred) 
Palo Alto:
PCNSE / PCNSA
Network / Telco:
CCNP / CCIE (Security or Service Provider)
Cloud / Telco:
NFV / Telco cloud certifications (optional)
 Soft Skills 
Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
Ability to operate in high pressure, carrier-grade environments 
Effective collaboration across global teams (NOC, SOC, Engineering)
Strong communication for client and stakeholder engagement
 Key Outcomes / Success Metrics 
High availability of Telco firewall services (carrier-grade SLAs)
Secure segmentation and traffic isolation across VNFs
Reduction in security incidents and faster RCA
Improved policy compliance and audit readiness
